road.title: Invitations
road.description: A small, square figure in an apron stiff with official starch, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Septimus is a Keeper of the Guest List and holds the list for an event nobody has announced and would like to know whether you are coming.

character.name: Septimus Brisket
character.description: A small, square figure in an apron stiff with official starch, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Septimus is a Keeper of the Guest List and holds the list for an event nobody has announced and would like to know whether you are coming.

npc.narrative: It is una bella mattina, and il cielo has nothing to declare. At a piccolo tavolo in the middle of the campo, Septimus Brisket squares a lunga lista with his penna, while il fieno waits to be asked.
npc.native: Buongiorno! Sono Septimus e ho la lista per una festa. Nessuno sa quando, ma io sono pronto. Ti va di venire?
npc.translation: Good morning! I am Septimus and I have the list for a party. Nobody knows when, but I am ready. Do you fancy coming?

player: Buongiorno Septimus! Sì, volentieri, mi piacciono le feste! Ma... quando è la festa?

verdict.overallFeedback: Your Italian was lovely and correct. You accepted gladly, said you like parties, and asked when the party is.

objectiveResults.feedback: Septimus invited you here, so this one is still open: you are meant to invite him to do something with you, like dinner or a coffee. He will give you another chance later.
Well done, "volentieri" is a warm and natural way to accept his invitation.
You accepted, so there was no need to decline here. Politely saying that unfortunately you cannot come will be asked for again later.

Tell Septimus politely that, unfortunately, you cannot come, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Septimus stands molto straight beside a small tavolo on the strada, a thick lista pinned under one elbow. The sole is already warm on the carta. He licks his matita and checks the margins, as if the festa had been filed under another letter.
npc.native: Anche a me piacciono le feste! Ma nessuno sa quando è la festa, e la lista è complicata come un grande orologio. Che cosa ti va di fare oggi?
npc.translation: I like parties too! But nobody knows when the party is, and the list is as complicated as a big clock. What do you feel like doing today?

player: Oggi voglio bere un caffè. Ti va di prendere un caffè con me stasera, al bar?

verdict.overallFeedback: Well done! You said you wanted a coffee and invited Septimus to join you at the bar, all in clear Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: You invited Septimus naturally with "Ti va di prendere un caffè con me stasera, al bar?", which is correct.

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: Ti va di prendere un caffè con me stasera, al bar?

objectiveResults.feedback: Here you were the one inviting. Gladly accepting an invitation from Septimus is still wanted, so it will come up again later.
This one wasn't needed in this answer. It is about politely telling Septimus that, unfortunately, you can't come, and it will come up again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Septimus has just invited you to something and is studying your face for the answer. Accept Septimus's invitation gladly, using Italian.
Tell Septimus politely that, unfortunately, you cannot come, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Septimus lowers his penna and studies you over the lista, like a man checking a stranger against a very short list of strangers. Across the piazza, the bar's tavolo and two sedie wait in the mattina sun, already arranged by someone.
npc.native: Un caffè al bar? Certo, è una bella idea! Io bevo il caffè volentieri, ma stasera controllo la lista. Domani mattina ti va di venire con me al bar?
npc.translation: A coffee at the bar? Of course, it is a nice idea! I drink coffee gladly, but tonight I check the list. Tomorrow morning, do you feel like coming with me to the bar?

player: Sì, con piacere! Domani mattina va benissimo. Ma la festa... mi dispiace, purtroppo stasera non posso venire.

verdict.overallFeedback: Well done! You accepted the morning coffee warmly and then politely said you can't come this evening, all in correct Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: You accepted Septimus's invitation gladly with "con piacere".
You politely said you can't come, using "purtroppo" and "non posso".

npc.narrative: The morning is chiaro, and the sole lies across the piazza like a tablecloth nobody has paid for. Septimus moves your name from one riga of the lista to another, with the pencil of a man who was once promoted. The page has no date on it, but he blows on the ink all the same.
npc.native: Perfetto, domani mattina al bar, con piacere! Purtroppo stasera non posso neanche io, e mi dispiace, ma la lista è lunga come un viaggio. Che cosa bevi di solito la mattina?
npc.translation: Perfect, tomorrow morning at the bar, with pleasure! Unfortunately I can't tonight either, and I'm sorry, but the list is as long as a journey. What do you usually drink in the morning?

player: La mattina bevo un cappuccino e mangio un cornetto. Chi c'è sulla lista? Ci sono molte persone?

npc.narrative: Il sole is already over the piazza, and Septimus stands in it with his lista pressed to his petto. He turns a pagina with great care, as if it might object. Beside him one sedia waits, vuota, for a guest nobody has named.
npc.native: Un cappuccino e un cornetto: che bella colazione! Sulla lista ci sono solo tre persone: io, tu e un signore con il cappello. Non sono molte, ma la lista è in ordine, come un grande calendario. Con chi fai colazione di solito?
npc.translation: A cappuccino and a croissant: what a lovely breakfast! On the list there are only three people: me, you and a gentleman with a hat. They are not many, but the list is in order, like a great calendar. Who do you usually have breakfast with?

player: Faccio colazione da solo, con il mio gatto. Chi è il signore con il cappello? Lo conosci?

npc.narrative: Septimus lowers the penna and checks the lista, which lies on the tavolo and has not been asked to do anything all week. The mattina is clear, and the sole falls across the page like a very small inspector. Behind him a cappello hangs on a gancio, molto still, not looking at anyone.
npc.native: Che bella colazione con un gatto! Il signore con il cappello lo conosco poco, perché non dice mai il suo nome. Il suo cappello è più complicato di un grande ponte. Come si chiama il tuo gatto?
npc.translation: What a lovely breakfast with a cat! I know the gentleman with the hat only a little, because he never says his name. His hat is more complicated than a big bridge. What is your cat called?

player: Si chiama Biscotto. Va bene Septimus, a domani al bar! Arrivederci!

npc.narrative: It is a bella mattina, and Septimus lifts his penna over a piccolo libro, where the gatto is entered sotto a heading that is not the lista. Somewhere a campana rings once, without conviction.
npc.native: Biscotto! È un nome perfetto per un gatto da colazione. Va bene, a domani al bar! Il mio piano è più complicato di un grande trattato, ma è scritto bene. Che cosa fa Biscotto la mattina?
npc.translation: Biscotto! It is a perfect name for a breakfast cat. All right, see you tomorrow at the bar! My plan is more complicated than a great treaty, but it is well written. What does Biscotto do in the morning?
